title: QR code generator: link, text or Wi-Fi
description: Create a QR code for a link, any text or a Wi-Fi network and download it as PNG or SVG. Free, no sign-up, no watermark.

ui.empty: Enter some text or a URL
ui.tooLong: Too much data for one QR code — shorten the text or choose a lower error correction level

colors.inverted: Many scanners can’t read a light code on a dark background — make the code darker than the background.
colors.low: The code and background are too close in brightness: it may not scan in poor light.
